title: 30002291: prior sufficient answer; verified extension with novelty unresolved
body:
The bounded-characteristic pure-jump theorem passes independent mathematical reconstruction, exact reproduction, three fresh analytic adversaries and source-scope review. Mathematical Sections2–7 are unchanged. All17 original files, including historical reviews and manifests, remain byte-identical under original_submission/.

Qualified historical classification: **already_solved** means the original open-ended sufficient-conditions request already had a substantial affirmative semimartingale answer in Basse-O'Connor–Heinrich–Podolskij, arXiv1604.02307v2 (2016), Theorem1.2(i), associated with the2018 Bernoulli article. It does **not** mean the entire arbitrary-predictable-kernel/index2 theorem was previously proved. Its exact novelty remains unresolved; the classes are nonnested. PRIORITY_AUDIT.md preserves the precise reciprocal-mesh qualification and source-access gaps, and adds the2018/2019 nonsymmetric Levy prior.

This is a documented historical judgment about an open-ended request, not a universal/maximal-class resolution or a full-anticipation claim. The verified extension is preserved for any separately motivated future investigation. AI tools were used extensively; unrefereed, with no human peer review claimed. Author turn1/5 remains unchanged.
